candidate_visible: Only inputs/<case-id>/request.md and inputs/<case-id>/fixture/ reach a candidate, through heldout_review.build. Oracles, controls, samples, this manifest, the freeze and the reviewer record stay outside every candidate mount, prompt and response schema.

adapter_notes: Review cases load scan/SKILL.md with the ordinary report-only request; scan may dispatch reviewer subagents within the protocol delegation cap.

feedback-repair loads remedy/SKILL.md. Remedy retrieves feedback through scripts/pr-threads and gh, while this request supplies the batch as a local file and the workspace has no forge. The second reviewer decides whether remedy reaches an equivalent executable route from the file, or whether both suites need the same offline gh double serving the batch, which would be a new freeze.
mana.resolved_from: git objects of the pinned commit; matches run.py --payload-inventory over git archive of skills/

adapter_notes: Review cases load skills/interrogate/SKILL.md, a report-only adversarial review that never applies changes. It fans out one read-only reviewer per configured model through the host task tool. With user configuration disabled its table defaults apply; the host may refuse those model slugs, and its fallback rule then runs reviewers on the closest accepted model. Reviewer fan-out shares the protocol delegation cap.

feedback-repair loads skills/poteto-mode/SKILL.md, whose routing sends review-automation comments to references/bugbot-triage.md for fix, dismiss or ask. Its babysit playbook polls a forge and has no local equivalent; the request supplies the batch as a file. poteto-mode also names deslop from cursor-team-kit, outside this package; docs/harness/claude-code.md says to skip a missing tool and continue. The second reviewer decides whether this is an equivalent executable route. If not, the protocol fails preparation for this case and the group needs a revised design.
interrogate output uses Act on, Consider, Noted and Dismissed buckets. Graders normalize only Act on as actionable, the same rule applied to Mana blocking findings.

exposure.rule: If anyone tuning a candidate reads a request, fixture, oracle, sample or this manifest, record the event here, set that case split to development and author an untouched replacement group (suffix -02) under a new freeze before confirmation.
